native_rule.CONFIG_DEFINES_not_injected_into_IIG: Actual native OTHER_IIG_CFLAGS uses platform define, not CONFIG_DEFINES/DEVELOPMENT.

limitations: Source generation with qualified public Nyktis IIG and an explicit portable libclang parser mapping only; no Apple private IIG ABI or SDK completeness qualification.
Generated implementations were not compiled or linked; no full kernel/runtime/hardware or native display result.
DEVELOPMENT binds the accepted native source/config context; actual DriverKit IIG flags carry platform defines, not CONFIG_DEFINES/DEVELOPMENT or KERNEL additions.
Raw per-command stdout and stderr are combined in retained logs; all17 actual logs are empty, not separate stream observations.
Resource observations use the existing sampled controller/session guard; no claim of an instantaneous project-wide RSS peak.
